en.title: Annette Badland Reflects on Mae's Unexpected Role in Ted Lasso's Penultimate Episode
en.summary: The heart of the Crown & Anchor, Mae, takes center stage in a pivotal Ted Lasso episode. Actress Annette Badland shares her thoughts on the character's evolving journey and her unique bond with the Lady Greyhounds.
en.body:
The penultimate episode of *Ted Lasso* Season 4, titled "The Lady Greyhounds," placed a spotlight squarely on the indomitable **Mae** (played by **Annette Badland**), the no-nonsense proprietor of the Crown & Anchor pub. While Ted Lasso's journey with AFC Richmond has always been the central narrative, this installment explored Mae's own significant impact, particularly her burgeoning role as a mentor and confidante to the newly formed women's team. Her pragmatic wisdom and unwavering support proved crucial as the Lady Greyhounds navigated their own challenges, mirroring the themes of belief and resilience that have defined the series.

**Annette Badland** recently spoke about the experience, reflecting on Mae's character arc and her connection to this new group of players. "It was a very bittersweet episode to film," Badland shared, hinting at the emotional weight of the storyline. "Mae has always been a pillar of the community, a steady presence. To see her step into this new capacity, guiding these young women, felt like a natural, albeit surprising, progression for her." The episode masterfully wove Mae's personal experiences into the team's struggles, showcasing how her past informed her present guidance. The narrative highlighted the often-unseen emotional labor of seasoned individuals stepping up to nurture the next generation, a theme that has been subtly building throughout the season.

## Mae's Pivotal Role in the Lady Greyhounds' Journey

The inclusion of the Lady Greyhounds as a significant plotline this season has been a welcome development for many viewers, offering a fresh perspective on the *Ted Lasso* universe. Episode 9, in particular, solidified Mae's integral position within this new dynamic. She wasn't just serving pints; she was offering life lessons, strategic advice, and a much-needed dose of tough love. This focus allowed fans to see a different facet of Mae, one that goes beyond her iconic pub setting and her interactions with Ted and the original AFC Richmond coaching staff. Her journey with the Lady Greyhounds is a testament to the show's commitment to exploring its characters' depths, proving that even the most established figures can embark on new and meaningful paths.

## Fan Reactions and Mae's Enduring Appeal

The fan community has largely embraced this deeper dive into Mae's character. Social media buzzed with appreciation for her no-nonsense approach and the genuine care she showed the Lady Greyhounds. Many viewers expressed how Mae's arc resonated with their own experiences of mentorship, both giving and receiving. Her ability to blend sternness with empathy has always made her a fan favorite, and this episode only amplified that sentiment. The storyline served as a poignant reminder of the show's core message: that everyone has something valuable to contribute, and that support can come from the most unexpected places. It underscored the show's talent for giving even its supporting characters moments that feel both earned and deeply impactful.

## What's Next

With the season finale on the horizon, the impact of Mae's involvement with the Lady Greyhounds is sure to continue shaping the narrative. Fans will be watching closely to see how this mentorship evolves and what final lessons Mae imparts as the season draws to a close.
